observations: Two photos show a large rectangular office table with a light brown wooden top and a black metal frame with four legs.
The table has a central circular hole in the top surface, likely for cable management.
The table is outdoors on a wet, paved ground, surrounded by other furniture and people.
The table appears to be in a used condition with visible wear and dirt on the legs and base.
The top surface shows some smudges and minor scratches, consistent with outdoor use.
No brand or model is visible on the table or its frame.
The seller claims it is 'good quality used but very clean'.

claims.claim: Office table with good quality used but very clean
claims.evidence: The table shows visible wear and dirt on the legs and base, contradicting 'very clean'. The top has smudges and scratches, which may indicate use. 'Good quality' is subjective and not verifiable from photos alone.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Structural damage or instability due to wear and dirt on legs and base
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the table legs and base, showing any cracks, warping, or loose joints.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unstable or damaged

risks.risk: Surface damage or scratches not visible in current lighting
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the top surface under direct light, showing depth of scratches and wear.

risks.risk: Table may not be functional (e.g., legs wobbly, top loose)
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the table being moved or tilted to test stability.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the table legs and base to check for cracks or damage.
Close-up photo of the top surface under direct light to assess scratches and wear.
Video or photo showing the table being moved or tilted to test stability.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
